offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results. Hobby: $19/month billed monthly, or $16/month billed annually, for 5,000 credits per month (2,500 searches).
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits / month；500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果；返回 titles、descriptions、URLs，可选返回每个结果的 markdown、HTML、links 或 screenshots
offerings.note: 结果含 query-relevant Highlights（默认）；搜索 1–10 条结果收费 2 credits，超过 10 条向上取整。
